Rashi on Ketubot 5a:1:1.hebrew: משום חשבונות - שאם יכנוס למוצאי שבת, יעשה סעודה בלילה ויחשוב בשבת מהו צריך להוציא, וכתיב: ודבר דבר (ישעיהו נח):
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:1:1.english: Due to calculations - For if he were to marry at the conclusion of Shabbat, he would make a feast at night and calculate on Shabbat what he needs to spend, and it is written: "nor speaking a word" (Isaiah 58).

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:2:1.english: They uncover - They bring out to the light.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:2:2.english: Clearing away - Descombrement in Old French [meaning extrication, or clearing away rubble].

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:3:1.english: Theaters - Palaces of kings and rulers.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:3:2.hebrew: ללמדו אומנות - מצוה הוא, דכתיב (קהלת ט׳:ט׳) ראה חיים עם אשה אשר אהבת, למוד אומנות שתחיה הימנו עם התורה, ואמרינן בקידושין (דף כט.) שאביו חייב ללמדו אומנות:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:3:2.english: To teach him a craft - It is a mitzvah, as it is written (Ecclesiastes 9:9): "See life with a woman whom you love" — [meaning,] learn a craft so that you may live from it along with the Torah. And we say in Kiddushin (page 29a) that his father is obligated to teach him a craft.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:1.hebrew: שמא ישחוט בן עוף - בשבת לצורך מוצאי שבת, שיהא טרוד וישכח שהוא שבת:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:1.english: Lest he slaughter a young bird - On Shabbat for the needs of Saturday night, as he will be preoccupied and forget that it is Shabbat.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:2.hebrew: שחל להיות בשני בשבת - שצריכין להרבות בסעודה אחר השבת, שהוא ערב יום כפורים:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:2.english: That occurs on Monday - For they are required to have an abundant meal after Shabbat, which is the eve of Yom Kippur.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:3.hebrew: ידחה - לשלישי בשבת, שמא ישחוט בן עוף לצורך סעודת מחר:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:3.english: Should be postponed - To Tuesday, lest one slaughter a young bird for the needs of tomorrow's meal.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:4.hebrew: אית ליה רווחא - לשחוט בלילה, שהסעודה אינה עד למחר:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:4.english: He has ample time - To slaughter at night, as the meal is not until the next day.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:5.hebrew: הכא לית ליה רווחא - שהסעודה בלילה אחר השבת, משחשיכה מיד:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:4:5.english: Here he does not have an interval - For the feast is at night after Shabbat, immediately once it gets dark.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:6:1.hebrew: ולא חיישינן לאיקרורי דעתא - אם לא ימצא לה בתולים, לא חיישינן שיתקרר כעסו בהאי פורתא:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:6:1.english: And we are not concerned about the cooling of [his] mind - If he does not find virginity for her, we are not concerned that his anger will cool down in this short [time].

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:6:2.english: And she engages in intercourse on Thursday - Once it grows dark on Wednesday and the night of Thursday begins.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:7:1.english: A blessing for the fish - "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters..." (Genesis 1:22).

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:7:2.english: Since a blessing was stated on it for man - "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth" (ibid.).

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:7:3.hebrew: טעמא משום ברכה - אבל מאן דלא קפיד אברכה, משום איקרורי דעתא לא חיישינן משום האי פורתא:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:7:3.english: The reason is because of the blessing - But for one who is not particular about the blessing, we are not concerned about the cooling of [his] mind for this short [time].

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:8:1.hebrew: ברכה דאדם עדיפא ליה - ומיהו בששי לא תנשא בתולה, דבזמן ארוך עד שני בשבת דאתו דייני חיישינן לאיקרורי, אבל מרביעי עד חמישי לא חיישינן:
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:8:1.english: The blessing of man is preferable to him - However, a virgin may not marry on Friday, for over a long period, until Monday when the judges arrive, we are concerned about [his anger] cooling down; but from Wednesday to Thursday, we are not concerned.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:9:1.hebrew: למחר משכים לאומנתו והולך - שאין משתה אלמון באלמנה אלא יום אחד, כדלקמן בפירקין (כתובות דף ז.):
Rashi on Ketubot 5a:9:1.english: On the morrow he rises early to his craft and goes - For the wedding feast of a widower with a widow is only one day, as [stated] later in our chapter (Ketubot 7a).

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:9:2.english: Thursday - The day of the wedding canopy.

Rashi on Ketubot 5a:9:3.english: And the sixth day of the week - [Due to] the affection of marital relations.

Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:4:1.hebrew: שמא ישחוט בן עוף - יש גורסים בו עוף, אע"ג דשבת לשון נקבה היא, דכתיב (שמות ל״א:י״ד) מחלליה מות יומת; ה"נ הוי לשון זכר: כל העושה בו מלאכה (שם לה), שומר שבת מחללו (ישעיהו נ״ו:ב׳). ושפיר גרסינן נמי בן עוף, דדרך בני אדם לשחוט הרכין והקטנים, כדכתיב (ויקרא ה׳:ז׳) שני בני יונה. ובפרק קמא דקידושין (דף לו: ושם): אתיא מבן עוף, מה לבן צאן שכן קבע לו כו':
Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:4:1.english: Lest he slaughter a young fowl - Some read "bo of" [on it, a fowl]; even though Shabbat is feminine, as it is written: "Those who desecrate it shall surely be put to death" (Exodus 31:14), so too is it [treated as] masculine: "Whoever does work on it" (ibid. 35:2), "One who guards the Sabbath from desecrating it" (Isaiah 56:2). And our reading of "ben of" [a young fowl] is also fine, for it is the way of people to slaughter the tender and small [fowls], as it is written: "two young pigeons" (Leviticus 5:7). And in the first chapter of Kiddushin (36b, and there [37b]): "[Can it be] derived from ben of [a fowl]? What of ben tzon [a sheep], for which [the verse] established, etc.?"

Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:4:2.hebrew: אלא מעתה יום הכפורים שחל להיות בשני כו' - תימה: אמאי נקט יום כפורים, דלא הוי אלא לרבי יוסי הגלילי, כדתנן (חולין דף פג.): בד' פרקים בשנה המוכר בהמה לחבירו צריך להודיעו: אמה מכרתי לשחוט כו', וכדברי רבי יוסי הגלילי אף ערב יום הכפורים בגליל; אמאי לא נקט חד מד' פרקים, דהוי לכ"ע? וי"ל, דבערב יום הכפורים היו רגילין להרבות בעופות ובדגים, כדמשמע בבראשית רבה (פי"א) גבי ההוא חייטא דזבן נונא כו', משום דהוי יום סליחה וכפרה; ובהנהו ד' פרקים היו מרבים בבהמות, דליכא למגזר שמא ישחוט:
Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:4:2.english: If so, Yom Kippur that occurs on Monday, etc. - [It is] puzzling: Why did [Abaye] cite Yom Kippur, which is [a time of widespread slaughter] only according to Rabbi Yosi HaGelili, as we learned in a mishna (Chullin 83a): "At four periods in the year, one who sells an animal to another must inform him: 'I sold its mother to slaughter,' etc., and according to the words of Rabbi Yosi HaGelili, even the eve of Yom Kippur in the Galilee"; why didn't he cite one of the four periods, which are [agreed upon] according to everyone? And one can say that on the eve of Yom Kippur they were accustomed to have an abundance of fowl and fish, as is implied in Bereshit Rabbah (chapter 11) regarding that tailor who bought a fish, etc., because it is a day of forgiveness and atonement; whereas during those four periods they would have an abundance of livestock, regarding which there is no [reason] to decree lest one slaughter [on Shabbat].

Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:8:1.hebrew: אי הכי אלמנה נמי תיבעל בחמישי - פי': בשלמא אי הוה תני בברייתא דבתולה נבעלת בחמישי משום איקרורי דעתא, כדקמיבעיא לן, ולא משום ברכה לדגים, דלא חשיבא, הוי ניחא לן באלמנה דנבעלת בששי משום ברכה; אבל השתא, דטעמא דבתולה משום ברכה, אלמנה נמי תיבעל בחמישי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:8:1.english: If so, a widow too should have intercourse on Thursday - Explanation: Granted, if the baraita had taught that a virgin has intercourse on Thursday because of the cooling of [his] temper, as we were inquiring, and not because of the blessing for the fish, which is not significant, it would be satisfactory to us regarding a widow that she has intercourse on Friday because of the blessing [to man]. But now that the reason for a virgin [having intercourse on Thursday] is because of the blessing, a widow too should have intercourse on Thursday!

Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:9:1.hebrew: אי נמי משום שקדו - וא"ת: והיכי מצי למימר משום שקדו, הא בברייתא קתני בהדיא משום ברכה? וי"ל, דלהאי שינויא הוי פירוש הברייתא הכי: אלמנה נשאת בחמישי ונבעלת בששי, פי' משום שקדו, כמו שמפורש בברייתא אחרת. וא"ת: משום ברכה דדגים היה להם להניח תקנת שקדו? לא חשו לכך, הואיל ובששי נמי נאמרה ברכה לאדם:
Tosafot on Ketubot 5a:9:1.english: Alternatively, because [the Sages] were assiduous (shakedu) - And if you say: How can [the Gemara] say [that it is] because [the Sages] were assiduous? Behold, in the baraita it explicitly teaches [that it is] because of the blessing! And one can say that according to this resolution, the explanation of the baraita is as follows: "A widow is married on Thursday and engages in intercourse on Friday" — [its] explanation is because [the Sages] were assiduous, as is explained in another baraita. And if you say: On account of the blessing of the fish, should they have set aside the enactment of *shakedu*? They were not concerned about this, since on Friday as well a blessing was stated to man.
